us.title: Anthropic Interview Question: Every Batch Takes 100 ms. Why Is the API Slow?
us.description: A worked system design problem about the waiting time your architecture diagram forgot. Let’s say your model finishes a batch in 100 milliseconds. Someone asks whether the API can respond in 100 milliseconds too, and suddenly the whiteboard feels a little less friendly. Because the model’s stopwatch starts after the waiting is over. Your user’s stopwatch does not. Imagine a shuttle promising a ten-minute ride. Lovely. You can still spend forty minutes at the stop while the driver waits for more passengers. Faster driving will not rescue that afternoon. This is why I like this reported Anthropic interview question: design an LLM inference service where every batch takes 100 ms. The full prompt is readable without an unlock. We will build our own answer, starting with one request rather than a heroic collection of infrastructure boxes. By the end, you should be able to explain when a batch leaves, how many workers you need, and when accepting another request becomes a promise you cannot keep. First, find out when the stopwatch starts Before choosing a queue, clarify what those 100 ms measure. For this walkthrough, assume they cover the model’s complete execution of one batch, not time to the first token and not the client’s entire round trip. We will also assume one model version, a maximum of 32 requests per batch, one batch at a time per worker, and whole responses rather than streaming. The fixed compute time holds for every supported batch size in this simplified exercise. Those are assumptions for our design, not claims about Anthropic’s production service. Now give the caller a provisional 200 ms end-to-end budget. Perhaps 20 ms goes to the inbound network and API work, 100 ms to the model, and 20 ms to returning the result. That leaves 60 ms for waiting. Those 60 ms must cover both deliberate waiting for a fuller batch and waiting because every worker is busy. They are not two separate allowances we get to spend twice. These numbers are an illustrative budget. They do not prove a p99 target: real network variation, service overhead and arrival bursts still need measurement. If the interviewer means 100 ms end to end while compute alone takes 100 ms, flag that the budget has no room for anything else. Give a half-empty batch permission to leave Waiting until all 32 slots fill sounds efficient until traffic gets quiet. One lonely request can sit there while the GPU is perfectly available. I prefer a rule that cares about both fullness and age. For a tiny example, shrink the batch limit to four and allow at most 10 ms of intentional batching delay. Start with an idle worker: Request A arrives at 0 ms. Start its waiting clock. Request B arrives at 7 ms. Keep the original clock; do not restart it. At 10 ms, send A and B together even though two seats are empty. Compute finishes at 110 ms. A spent 110 ms in this part of the service; B spent 103 ms. Now change the arrivals: four requests appear together at 0 ms. Send the full batch immediately, and it finishes at 100 ms. There is no reason to wait out a timer that has already done its job. That gives us a useful scheduler rule: when a compatible worker is free, dispatch if the batch is full, the oldest request has reached its batching-delay limit, or waiting longer would threaten a request’s deadline. Otherwise, wait for the next arrival or relevant timer. The timer limits intentional delay; it does not manufacture a free worker. If the only worker is busy until 100 ms, a request that arrived at 1 ms can wait 99 ms before its own compute begins. A 10 ms batch timer cannot make that request meet our earlier budget. Keep the oldest arrival timestamp while a worker is busy. When capacity returns, dispatch an overdue partial batch immediately rather than starting a fresh 10 ms timer. This is a small implementation detail with a very visible effect on the person waiting. NVIDIA’s Triton batching documentation describes configurable batching delays and queue policies for stateless models. It is a useful implementation reference; our 10 ms setting is a teaching choice, not a universal recommendation. Do the capacity math before ordering more GPUs Under the fixed-time assumption, one worker completes ten batches each second. With 32 requests in every batch, its ideal throughput is 320 requests per second. For an illustrative arrival rate of 1,000 requests per second, the arithmetic minimum is four workers: 1,000 divided by 320, rounded up. Three workers can finish only 960 requests per second even in this idealized case, so a sustained 1,000-request arrival rate makes the queue grow. Four workers provide an ideal capacity of 1,280 requests per second, putting the offered load at about 78% of that capacity. Five provide 1,600, bringing it to 62.5%. Lovely arithmetic, but please do not turn the last number into a latency guarantee. It assumes full batches, zero overhead and no failures. With an average batch size of 16, the same fixed-time model gives only 160 requests per second per continuously busy worker. Five workers are a candidate configuration to measure, not the answer handed down by the spreadsheet. Track actual batch sizes, oldest queued-request age, accepted and rejected traffic, and end-to-end latency percentiles. Provision headroom for the arrival pattern you actually have. Autoscaling should consider queued work and deadline pressure, not just GPU utilization. Keep warm capacity when model loading is slow; a worker that arrives after the caller’s deadline cannot save that request. Now draw the boxes, including the way back Our first architecture can stay small: client → API frontend → bounded queue for the model version → scheduler → model worker. Results travel back through the frontend to their original callers. At admission, validate input size and supported settings, authenticate the caller, and attach a request ID, tenant identity, arrival time, deadline and reply destination. Store the waiting connection or future in a request-ID lookup at the frontend. The scheduler does not need to hold an HTTP connection itself. Return each result with its request ID and attempt identifier. Batch position is a fragile routing contract once retries, cancellations or filtering can change the membership. Resolve the matching waiting request once, and discard stale attempts or late results. If several model versions are supported, keep compatible queues and route to workers that already have the appropriate weights. Two requests being next to each other in a queue does not make their models compatible. Put tenant quotas or fair scheduling in front of the shared capacity so one enthusiastic caller cannot occupy the entire waiting room. Decide what admission actually promises For a synchronous service, we can explicitly allow a frontend crash to fail the connection and require a client retry. If accepted work must survive that crash, we need durable request state, result storage and a reconnect or polling contract. A durable queue alone does not restore a vanished connection. Bound the queue by count and memory, and expire requests whose deadlines have passed. Reject excess work with an appropriate overload response rather than silently accepting an ever-growing backlog. Use a shared retry budget and backoff with jitter so clients do not all return at the same instant. An estimated completion time can help admission decisions, but it is still an estimate. If a request cannot plausibly fit within its remaining budget, say so early. Waiting until the deadline to admit defeat wastes both the caller’s time and your capacity. One broken request should not get unlimited second chances Happy-path batching is pleasantly tidy. Failure handling is where I want the explanation to become precise. If a worker dies mid-batch: identify the unfinished requests and retry only those still within their deadlines and attempt budgets. Use leases or equivalent ownership tracking if work can move between workers. Fence old attempts so a late response cannot complete the same request twice. If one request repeatedly crashes a batch: validate predictable bad inputs before scheduling. For unexplained failures, isolate the suspected request or split the failing group with a strict retry budget. Never keep replaying the same failing group forever. If a caller times out or disconnects: remove queued work where possible and propagate cancellation to the execution engine when supported. Already-running GPU work may not stop immediately; prevent its eventual output from reviving an expired request. Inference may execute twice after an ambiguous failure. Completion deduplication protects the response contract, but it does not magically guarantee exactly-once compute. If a client expects retries to replay the original result, keep a tenant-scoped idempotency record with the request fingerprint and saved result. Regeneration is not necessarily identical. Then let the 100 ms assumption go Only after solving the stated problem should we relax it. Real generative requests have different prompt lengths and output lengths; request count alone is a poor description of the work or memory they consume. Consider token and memory budgets, compatible model settings, and separate handling for interactive and bulk work. A short response should not wait for a much longer response merely because they started together. With continuous batching, an engine can schedule active sequences across decoding steps and admit new work as other sequences finish. vLLM documents continuous batching among its serving features. This changes the scheduler model; it does not make arbitrary generations finish in 100 ms. For streaming, measure time to first token, time between tokens and full completion separately. A prompt first token can still be followed by a frustratingly slow answer. Keep the metric attached to the experience you promised. Here is the practice exercise worth keeping Close the explanation and redraw the system from memory. Use one worker, a batch limit of four, a 10 ms batching delay and 100 ms compute. Then trace these three situations by hand: Sparse arrivals: A at 0 ms and B at 7 ms. Explain why the batch leaves at 10 ms and why the callers wait different amounts. A busy worker: four requests start at 0 ms; E arrives at 1 ms. With no other worker, E can start at 100 ms and finish at 200 ms. Explain why the batch timer did not cap its total wait. A deadline expires: give E a deadline of 150 ms. Even immediate dispatch when the worker frees up would finish too late. State when you reject or expire it and how you handle any late result. For these exercises, ignore network and frontend overhead and assume no further arrivals. The point is to make every timestamp defensible before adding more boxes. My favorite part of this question is that a fast model does not let us skip ordinary engineering. Someone still has to decide who waits, how long they wait, and what happens when the promise no longer fits. Try the prompt linked near the beginning before reading another solution, and change one constraint yourself. If these worked interview questions help, follow me or subscribe for the next walkthrough. I would love to hear which policy you choose first whether sending a smaller batch sooner, or wait for better utilization and what would make you change your mind? ~ Emily

gr.title: Πώς θα κυβερνήσει ένα αμεσοδημοκρατικό, φοιτητικό κίνημα τη Σερβία;
gr.description: Το οριζόντιο, αμεσοδημοκρατικό κίνημα επιδιώκει την «ανασυγκρότηση της κοινωνίας» στη Σερβία, μετά από χρόνια αυταρχικής διακυβέρνησης. Ύστερα από μια σαρωτική εκλογική νίκη το Σαββατοκύριακο, η σερβική «Φοιτητική Λίστα» προετοιμάζεται για διαπραγματεύσεις για τον σχηματισμό κυβέρνησης, με στόχο την ανατροπή του εθνικιστικού και όλο και πιο αυταρχικού καθεστώτος που επικράτησε τα τελευταία 14 χρόνια. Τη Δευτέρα, οι υποστηρικτές του κινήματος - το οποίο δεν διαθέτει καμία κυβερνητική εμπειρία - βγήκαν στους δρόμους για να πανηγυρίσουν την αλλαγή σελίδας στη χώρα, μετά την βαριά ήττα του μέχρι πρότινος πανίσχυρου προέδρου, Αλεξάνταρ Βούτσιτς. Ο Βούτσιτς παραδέχθηκε την ήττα του αργά το βράδυ της Κυριακής, βάζοντας απότομο τέλος στην πολυετή κυριαρχία του στη σερβική πολιτική σκηνή. Η εξέλιξη αυτή αποτελεί την κορύφωση των αντικυβερνητικών διαδηλώσεων που σάρωσαν τη χώρα τα τελευταία δύο χρόνια, οι οποίες είχαν ξεσπάσει μετά την τραγική κατάρρευση του στεγάστρου στον σιδηροδρομικό σταθμό του Νόβι Σαντ, όπου έχασαν τη ζωή τους 16 άνθρωποι. Με την ενσωμάτωση στο 100%, οι εκτιμήσεις του Κέντρου Ελεύθερων Εκλογών και Δημοκρατίας στο Βελιγράδι φέρνουν τη «Φοιτητική Λίστα» στο 53% και τις 141 έδρες στη Βουλή των 250 εδρών. Αντίστοιχα, το Σερβικό Προοδευτικό Κόμμα (SNS) του Βούτσιτς περιορίστηκε στο 39% και τις 103 έδρες, ενώ οι υπόλοιπες κατανεμήθηκαν σε ψηφοδέλτια εθνικών μειονοτήτων. Προς το παρόν, παραμένει θολό το πώς ακριβώς θα κυβερνήσει ένα κίνημα που βασίζεται στη συλλογική λήψη αποφάσεων. Το ψηφοδέλτιο απαρτιζόταν από ακαδημαϊκούς, ηθοποιούς, αγρότες αλλά και φοιτητές. Ωστόσο, η έλλειψη εσωτερικής ιεραρχίας και η συνειδητή επιλογή να μην υπάρχει ένας κεντρικός ηγέτης καθιστούν αβέβαιο το ποια πρόσωπα θα αναλάβουν τελικά τη πρωθυπουργία και τα υπουργικά χαρτοφυλάκια. Ανάμεσα στα πιο αναγνωρίσιμα στελέχη της «Λίστας» συγκαταλέγονται ο καρδιολόγος Ιλίγια Σρντανοβιτς (Ilija Srdanović), ο οποίος ήταν επικεφαλής του ψηφοδελτίου, ο πρώην διοικητής της Κεντρικής Τράπεζας Ντέγιαν Σόσκιτς (Dejan Šoškić), καθώς και ο καθηγητής Χημείας στο Πανεπιστήμιο του Βελιγραδίου Ράντομιρ Σάιτσιτς (Radomir Saičić), ο οποίος ανέλαβε να εκπροσωπήσει το κίνημα στις πρώτες δηλώσεις μετά τη νίκη. Όπως συνέβη και με το κόμμα Tisza του Πέτερ Μαγιάρ στην Ουγγαρία - το οποίο την περασμένη άνοιξη έβαλε τέλος στη 16χρονη διακυβέρνηση του Βίκτορ Όρμπαν - έτσι και η «Λίστα» καλείται τώρα να διαχειριστεί έναν κρατικό μηχανισμό στελεχωμένο από δημόσιους λειτουργούς πρόσκειμενους στο προηγούμενο καθεστώς, γεγονός που δυσχεραίνει τις δομικές μεταρρυθμίσεις. «Όλοι στο φοιτητικό κίνημα, όπως και κάθε υποψήφιος της λίστας μας, συνειδητοποιούμε απόλυτα το βάρος της ευθύνης που αναλαμβάνουμε», δήλωσε η Άνα Μίρκοβιτς, ψυχολόγος, πανεπιστημιακός και υποψήφια με τη «Φοιτητική Λίστα». «Δεν εκλαμβάνουμε το αποτέλεσμα των εκλογών ως κατάληψη της εξουσίας ή απόκτηση προνομίων, αλλά ως ανάληψη ενός ιστορικού χρέους απέναντι στον λαό και τα παιδιά μας». «Το κράτος δεν θα γίνει ποτέ ξανά λάφυρο στα χέρια κανενός» Μιλώντας στον Guardian, η Μίρκοβιτς υπογράμμισε ότι απόλυτη προτεραιότητα της νέας διακυβέρνησης είναι η «κοινωνική και ψυχολογική αποτοξίνωση» της Σερβίας. Η 14χρονη παρουσία του Βούτσιτς στην εξουσία χαρακτηρίζεται από αναλυτές ως «αντιπροσωπευτικό δείγμα αυταρχικού καθεστώτος», καθώς το κόμμα του είχε θέσει υπό τον πλήρη έλεγχό του τα ΜΜΕ, τη δικαιοσύνη και τους κρατικούς θεσμούς, ενώ οι εκλογικές αναμετρήσεις συνοδεύονταν συχνά από καταγγελίες για παρατυπίες στους εκλογικούς καταλόγους, χειραγώγηση των μέσων και εξαγορά ψήφων. Το πρόγραμμα των φοιτητών επικεντρώνεται στην πάταξη της διαφθοράς και την αποκατάσταση του κράτους δικαίου. Στις βασικές εξαγγελίες περιλαμβάνεται η σύσταση μιας ανεξάρτητης αστυνομικής υπηρεσίας που θα υπάγεται απευθείας στις εισαγγελικές αρχές και όχι στο υπουργείο Εσωτερικών, καθώς και η κάθαρση των σωμάτων ασφαλείας από στοιχεία που συνδέονται με το οργανωμένο έγκλημα. Παράλληλα, προβλέπεται η απαγόρευση κομματικών διορισμών σε δημόσιες επιχειρήσεις, καθώς και ο αυστηρός δημόσιος έλεγχος - μέσω νέων, ανεξάρτητων ελεγκτικών μηχανισμών - σε όλες τις μεγάλες συμβάσεις δημόσιων υποδομών, ώστε να μπει τέλος στην κατάχρηση του δημοσίου χρήματος. Η Μίρκοβιτς πρόσθεσε ότι η νέα κυβέρνηση είναι αποφασισμένη να διαλύσει το «σύστημα εκφοβισμού» που συντηρούσε την πόλωση στη χώρα. Αυτό θα επιτευχθεί με το άμεσο άνοιγμα των ΜΜΕ, την άρση των πιέσεων προς τους δημοσίους υπαλλήλους και τον τερματισμό της «θεσμικής βίας». Όπως τόνισε, στόχος είναι «η εκ βάθρων ανασυγκρότηση της κοινωνίας: πλήρης διαφάνεια στις κρατικές συμβάσεις και τις ροές χρήματος, αποκομματικοποίηση και ενδυνάμωση της δικαιοσύνης, καθώς και ριζική ανανεωση της παιδείας και της υγείας», ώστε να διασφαλιστεί ότι το κράτος «δεν θα γίνει ποτέ ξανά λάφυρο στα χέρια κανενός». «Μέχρι χθες όλα αυτά φάνταζαν εξωπραγματικά», οι προκλήσεις είναι πολλές Κατά τη διάρκεια της προεκλογικής περιόδου, η «Φοιτητική Λίστα» απέφυγε συνειδητά να τοποθετηθεί σε ακανθώδη ζητήματα εξωτερικής πολιτικής, όπως οι σχέσεις της Σερβίας με την ΕΕ και τη Ρωσία. Από την πλευρά του, το Κρεμλίνο σχολίασε τη Δευτέρα πως ελπίζει οι νέοι ηγέτες «να αντιληφθούν ότι η διατήρηση της συνεργασίας με τη Ρωσία είναι προς το συμφέρον της Σερβίας». Ο πολιτικός αναλυτής Ντούσαν Βούτσιτσεβιτς σημείωσε ότι το κίνημα επέμεινε από την πρώτη στιγμή στην ανάγκη «να δοθεί απόλυτη προτεραιότητα στα εσωτερικά ζητήματα της χώρας - στην ουσιαστική αποσυναρμολόγηση κάθε θεσμικού στεγανού, από το κεντρικό έως το τοπικό επίπεδο». Η εκλογική επικράτηση των φοιτητών σηματοδοτεί μια βαθιά πολιτική καμπή για τη Σερβία και ενδέχεται να λειτουργήσει ως πηγή έμπνευσης για ανάλογα φοιτητικά κινήματα που έχουν ξεπηδήσει το τελευταίο διάστημα στην Ευρώπη, διεκδικώντας καλύτερη παιδεία και προοπτικές για τη νέα γενιά. Ωστόσο, ο Βούτσιτσεβιτς επεσήμανε ότι η περίπτωση της Σερβίας διαφέρει: «Αυτό το πείραμα άμεσης δημοκρατίας από τη βάση κατάφερε να συγκεντρώσει πάνω από το 50% των ψήφων», δήλωσε στο Agence France-Presse, συμπληρώνοντας πάντως πως «είναι αβέβαιο αν ένα τέτοιο μοντέλο θα μπορούσε να εφαρμοστεί με επιτυχία σε άλλες χώρες». Από την πλευρά του, ο Νίκολα Μπουράζερ, διευθυντής προγράμματος στο Κέντρο Σύγχρονης Πολιτικής στο Βελιγράδι, τόνισε ότι το κίνημα οφείλει πλέον να επιταχύνει τις διαδικασίες λήψης αποφάσεων, σημειώνοντας ότι η επιλογή των υποψηφίων για τα ψηφοδέλτια «πήρε υπερβολικά πολύ χρόνο - ολόκληρους μήνες». «Μόλις κοπάσουν οι πανηγυρισμοί και συνειδητοποιήσουμε τι ακριβώς συνέβη, το ενδιαφέρον θα στραφεί στο τι μέλλει γενέσθαι και ποια μορφή θα λάβει η νέα κυβέρνηση. Μέχρι χθες, όλα αυτά φάνταζαν εξωπραγματικά», συμπλήρωσε. Την Κυριακή, ο Βούτσιτς - ο οποίος καθ' όλη τη διάρκεια της θητείας του διατήρησε στενούς δεσμούς με τη Μόσχα - απέδωσε την ήττα του κόμματός του στην «άμεση εμπλοκή και υποστήριξη ευρωπαϊκών χωρών, αλλά και του βαθέος κράτους των ΗΠΑ, του ίδιου που στρέφεται και κατά του Προέδρου Τραμπ». Στο μεταξύ, η διεθνής κοινότητα υποδέχθηκε με θετικό τρόπο τη νίκη του φοιτητικού κινήματος. «Πρόκειται αναμφίβολα για ένα νέο κεφάλαιο στην ιστορία της χώρας και του λαού της», δήλωσε ο ουκρανός πρόεδρος Βολοντίμιρ Ζελένσκι, προσθέτοντας: «Ευχόμαστε στη Σερβία πρόοδο, πραγματική ανάπτυξη και στενές σχέσεις με την ευρωπαϊκή οικογένεια. Εκφράζουμε την ευγνωμοσύνη μας για τον σεβασμό που δείχνει η Σερβία στον λαό, την επικράτεια και την ανεξαρτησία μας». Παράλληλα, ο γερμανός καγκελάριος Φρίντριχ Μερτς υπογράμμισε ότι το Βερολίνο «θα στηρίξει ενεργά την ευρωπαϊκή προοπτική της Σερβίας», σημειώνοντας πως οι φοιτητές «έπεισαν τους πολίτες προτάσσοντας τα αιτήματα για κράτος δικαίου, καταπολέμηση της διαφθοράς και προάσπιση των θεμελιωδών ελευθεριών». in.title: UP on alert over Cyclone ‘Arnab’, Yogi Government engaged in relief and rescue preparations
in.description: Lucknow: Under the potential impact of Cyclone ‘Arnab’, unseasonal rain, thunderstorms and strong winds are likely in Uttar Pradesh between October 28 and 31. In view of this, the Yogi government has been put on alert. In light of the forecast, the Uttar Pradesh Relief Commissioner’s Office has issued precautionary guidelines for the general public and farmers. In view of the anticipated weather changes, the state government has emphasized relief and rescue preparations, along with precautionary measures. According to the weather forecast, winds are likely to blow at 30 to 40 kilometers per hour on October 28 in Sonbhadra, Mirzapur, Chandauli, Varanasi, Bhadohi, Ghazipur, and Ballia. India Meteorological Department has issued a yellow alert for these districts. Meanwhile, an orange alert has been issued for October 29 due to the possibility of heavy rainfall in several districts and strong winds blowing at speeds of 40 to 50 kilometers per hour. Rainfall is forecast in several areas, including Chitrakoot, Kaushambi, Prayagraj, Fatehpur, Pratapgarh, Rae Bareli, Amethi and Sultanpur. On October 30, heavy rain and strong winds are also likely in Bareilly, Pilibhit, and Shahjahanpur, along with several districts of Purvanchal, Awadh, and the Terai region. As a result, daytime temperatures may fall by 5 to 8 degrees Celsius. Relief Commissioner’s Office has urged people to follow weather-related warnings and the administration’s instructions. During storms, people have been advised to take shelter in permanent buildings, stay away from trees, electricity poles and weak structures, and avoid unnecessary travel. They have also been advised to avoid open fields, agricultural land and areas near water bodies during lightning. Farmers have been advised to take necessary precautions to protect their crops and agricultural produce, and to keep their livestock in safe places. People have been urged to check official weather bulletins and alerts on the Sachet app for the latest updates.

in.title: Rashmika Mandanna & Vijay Deverakonda's Manager Files Cyber Complaint Amid Koffee With Karan Trolling Row
in.description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's team has approached the cybercrime authorities in Hyderabad over alleged online harassment and the circulation of misleading content about them following their appearance on Koffee with Karan. Why Did Rashmika & Vijay's Manager File A Cyber Complaint? According to a press note released by the actors’ team, their manager, P Nishanth Kumar, has lodged a formal complaint requesting an investigation into social media posts allegedly involving fabricated information, doctored screenshots, impersonation and targeted harassment. The team has also reportedly provided relevant links and supporting material to help the authorities examine the matter. © Instagram/Vijay DeverakondaClarifying the intention behind the complaint, the actors’ representatives stated that the move was not aimed at restricting freedom of expression or preventing people from voicing genuine criticism. bd.title: Agile Robots Launches Agile ONE SN Humanoid at NVIDIA GTC Berlin and Pilots Humanoids with Audi
bd.description: BERLIN, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On 21 October, Agile Robots and NVIDIA launched the research humanoid Agile ONE SN at NVIDIA GTC Berlin. Agile Robots has released its new-generation Diana 7 and Diana 3 arms, both supporting the Franka Control Interface (FCI). Agile ONE SN: humanoid reference platform Agile ONE SN is built on the NVIDIA Isaac GR00T development platform. The 1.4-metre, 43-kilogram humanoid has dual WUJI tactile five-finger hands and 71 degrees of freedom in total, runs on NVIDIA Jetson Thor and ships with the GR00T 1.7 open VLA model. Skills developed on it can transfer to the full-size industrial Agile ONE. Availability is planned for early 2027. Jensen Huang (left) and Dr. Zhaopeng Chen (right) Two days earlier, at the Invest in Germany Summit in Berlin, NVIDIA announced plans to invest in Agile Robots. "Agile ONE SN gives R&D labs around the world a complete humanoid platform that is ready from day one," said Dr. Zhaopeng Chen, founder and CEO of Agile Robots. Application: humanoids in Audi's logistics Agile Robots, AUDI AG, Dassault Systèmes and NVIDIA also announced a joint project at Audi's Ingolstadt plant. In the Audi Production Lab, mobile humanoids pick parts from containers and sequence them for final assembly, a task performed around one million times a day. The workcell is first tested in a DELMIA virtual twin accelerated by NVIDIA Omniverse libraries. https://lnkd.in/p/gGBsBX78 Diana 7 and Diana 3: one interface, from lab to industrial payloads Diana 7 extends Franka Research 3 to higher payloads and reach, while Diana 3 brings the same force-control platform to entry-level research. Both share ±0.05 mm repeatability and 0.5 N relative force-control accuracy, and both support FCI, so Franka Research 3 code moves directly to Diana. Diana 3 keeps seven degrees of freedom, joint torque sensing and compliant control for precision manipulation, lab automation and sample handling. Diana 7, shown at the 26th China International Industry Fair in Shanghai (12–16 October), offers 7 kg payload and 923 mm reach, and weighs 2 kg less than before. ae.title: iPhone Duo cracks and lines: Apple says it will replace units showing screen problems
ae.description: SAN FRANCISCO: Days after launching its first folding iPhone, Apple acknowledged on Monday that some of the devices exhibit display problems and said it will replace them. Apple started shipping the iPhone Duo last week, with customers around the world lining up for tight inventory after initial online orders sold out in minutes. Analysts have said Apple is likely to face supply constraints because the iPhone Duo, which unfolds like a passport booklet, is complex to manufacture. Over the weekend, social media posts showed the iPhone Duo with cracks and lines in the inner display along the central hinge where the iPhone Duo folds. Apple acknowledged the problems on Monday, saying affected units tend to show the problem quickly. "We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units," Apple said in a statement. "If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement." Apple did not comment on what might cause the issue. iFixit, a firm that publishes teardown reports of electronic devices along with guides on how to repair them, said it used teardown footage, patents and CT scans to construct a 3D simulation of the iPhone Duo hinge that it compared with the reported damage locations. iFixit said its simulations found the reported damage clustered just below where a display cable runs under the screen near a central support bar. That bar might be failing to drop out of the screen's way as the phone is folded, "creating a small stress hotspot near the reported break location," the company said. Apple did not immediately comment on iFixit's findings, which also concluded that the iPhone Duo is the most repairable foldable phone that it has tested. Francisco Jeronimo, a vice president at market research firm IDC, said Apple's quick replacement offer was the "right first step" in responding to the problems. "We all remember when Samsung experienced problems with the original Galaxy Fold in 2019, but it also showed that a fast and transparent response can contain the damage to a category," Jeronimo said.

sa.description: نبّه المركز الوطني للأرصاد اليوم، من أتربة مثارة على منطقة نجران، مصحوبة برياح نشطة تصل سرعتها إلى (40-49) كم/ساعة، تؤدي إلى تدنٍ في مدى الرؤية الأفقية (3-5) كيلومترات، على مدينة نجران، ومحافظات بدر الجنوب، ويدمة، وثار، وحبونا، وخباش. وبيّن المركز أن الحالة ستستمر حتى الساعة السابعة مساءً. ونبّه المركز الوطني للأرصاد اليوم، من موجة ضباب على المنطقة الشرقية، تشمل مدينتي الدمام والظهران، ومحافظات: الجبيل، ورأس تنورة، والقطيف، والخبر، وبقيق، والعديد، والأحساء والهجر والمراكز التابعة لها؛ مما تسبب في تدني مدى الرؤية الأفقية (1 - 3) كلم في الطرق السريعة والمناطق المفتوحة، مبينًا أن هذه الحالة ستستمر -بمشيئة الله تعالى- حتى الساعة الثامنة صباحًا. وحذّر المركز من هطول أمطار خفيفة يصاحبها هبوب رياح نشطة على محافظات: حفر الباطن، الخفجي، النعيرية، قرية العليا؛ مما تسبب في إثارة الأتربة وتدني الرؤية الأفقية في (1 - 3) كلم في الطرق السريعة والمناطق المفتوحة، وارتفاع الأمواج في المناطق الساحلية، مبينًا أن هذه الحالة ستستمرحتى الساعة التاسعة مساءً. طقس المملكة يتوقع المركز الوطني للأرصاد في تقريره عن حالة الطقس اليوم الثلاثاء على مناطق المملكة، استمرار هطول أمطار رعدية متوسطة إلى غزيرة تؤدي إلى جريان السيول، مصحوبة بزخات من البرد على أجزاء من مناطق جازان وعسير والباحة ومكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة وحائل وتبوك والجوف والحدود الشمالية. وتكون خفيفة إلى متوسطة على أجزاء من منطقتي القصيم والشرقية، في حين تنشط الرياح السطحية المثيرة للأتربة والغبار على أجزاء من تلك المناطق، كذلك على أجزاء من منطقة الرياض.

sa.title: ابيضاض مرجان فرسان.. إنذار لا حكم بالموت
sa.description: يثير تحول لون بعض الشعاب المرجانية في مياه جزر فرسان إلى الأبيض تساؤلات بشأن سلامة هذا النظام البيئي الحساس، وسط مخاوف من تأثير ارتفاع حرارة البحر في قدرة المرجان على البقاء. ورغم ارتباط الابيضاض بالإجهاد الحراري، فإن تغير اللون لا يكفي للحكم بموت الشعاب، ما يجعل الفحص الميداني ضرورة لتحديد حجم التأثر وفرص التعافي. علاقة تكافلية أوضح الأستاذ الدكتور عبدالله الفرساني، أستاذ الجينات والأحياء الطبية الجزيئية بجامعة جازان، أن المرجان يعتمد على علاقة تكافلية مع طحالب مجهرية تعيش داخل أنسجته، وتزوده بجزء مهم من احتياجاته الغذائية، فضلًا عن إكسابه ألوانه الطبيعية. وأضاف أن ارتفاع حرارة المياه فوق مستويات التحمل قد يدفع المرجان إلى طرد تلك الطحالب أو فقد نسبة منها، فتظهر هياكله البيضاء عبر أنسجته الشفافة. وبيّن الفرساني أن ابيضاض المرجان لا يعني موته تلقائيًا، إذ يمكن للشعاب استعادة طحالبها وألوانها حين تتراجع الضغوط البيئية وتتحسن ظروف المياه. أما استمرار الحرارة المرتفعة لفترات طويلة، فقد يؤدي إلى تضرر الأنسجة الحية وموتها. وشدد على أهمية التمييز بين المرجان الذي تعرض للابيضاض والمرجان الميت، عبر فحص الأنسجة وقياس حرارة المياه، بدلًا من الاعتماد على المظهر الخارجي وحده. شهادة الصيادين وفي شهادة ميدانية، قال الصياد حميد العبسي لـ«الوطن» إن ارتفاع حرارة البحر تسبب، بحسب ملاحظاته، في موت بعض الشعاب المرجانية في مناطق يعرفها الصيادون. وتعكس إفادته قلق العاملين في البحر من تغيرات تمس موائل الأسماك والتنوع البحري، لكنها لا تغني عن التحقق العلمي. وتبرز الحاجة إلى رصد دوري للمواقع المتأثرة، وتوثيق تطور حالتها ومؤشرات التعافي، بما يتيح للجهات المعنية تقييم المخاطر واتخاذ إجراءات حماية تستند إلى بيانات موثوقة. وتكتسب هذه المتابعة أهمية لارتباط الشعاب بالتنوع البحري ومصادر رزق الصيادين في الجزر. أبرز النقاط: صيادو فرسان يرصدون موت بعض الشعاب ويربطونه بارتفاع حرارة البحر ابيضاض الشعاب لا يعني موتها، والتعافي ممكن بتحسن الظروف البيئية الرصد الدوري والفحص الميداني ضروريان لتقييم الأضرار وتحديد فرص التعافي

iq.title: بدعم من أبطال آسيا.. الدوري العراقي على أعتاب إنجاز تاريخي في التصنيف القاري
iq.description: شفق نيوز - بغداد اقترب الدوري العراقي من تجاوز نظيره الأردني في تصنيف الدوريات الآسيوية، بعدما عزز رصيده بنحو 2000 نقطة، إثر فوز القوة الجوية على باختاكور الأوزبكي مساء أمس ضمن منافسات دوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة، في خطوة مهمة نحو تحسين موقع الكرة العراقية قارياً. وتكتسب مباراة الشرطة أمام الحسين إربد الأردني، ضمن دوري أبطال آسيا 2 المقررة مساء اليوم في بغداد، أهمية كبيرة في سباق التصنيف؛ إذ إن تحقيق الشرطة للفوز سيمنح الدوري العراقي فرصة تجاوز الدوري الأردني والتقدم إلى المركز الثاني عشر آسيوياً، في حال اعتماد نتائج هذه الجولة. واحتل الدوري العراقي عقب فوز الجوية المركز الثالث عشر في التصنيف برصيد 40.013 نقطة، بفارق 0.533 نقطة عن الدوري الأردني صاحب المركز الثاني عشر برصيد 40.546 نقطة، ما يجعل مواجهة الشرطة المرتقبة محطة مفصلية لتقليص الفارق والتقدم في سلم الترتيب. وجاء ترتيب الدوريات الآسيوية وفق النقاط المعلنة على النحو الآتي: السعودية أولاً برصيد 117.798 نقطة، تليها اليابان بـ 106.174 نقاط، ثم كوريا الجنوبية بـ 76.437 نقطة، والإمارات بـ 73.031 نقطة، وإيران بـ 62.161 نقطة، وقطر بـ 59.802 نقطة، وتايلاند بـ 53.447 نقطة، وأستراليا بـ 46.078 نقطة، وأوزبكستان بـ 44.016 نقطة، وماليزيا بـ 43.142 نقطة، والصين بـ 42.564 نقطة، والأردن بـ 40.546 نقطة، ثم العراق بـ 40.013 نقطة، وسنغافورة بـ 36.088 نقطة، وفيتنام بـ 35.241 نقطة. وتتطلع الأندية العراقية إلى مواصلة تحقيق النتائج الإيجابية في البطولات القارية، بما يسهم في رفع رصيد البلاد وتحسين موقعها في التصنيف الآسيوي، وتعزيز حضور الكرة العراقية بين كبار دوريات القارة.

iq.description: شفق نيوز- متابعة أعلنت شركة آبل عن جهازها اللوحي الجديد iPad mini، واصفة إياه بأنه التحديث الأهم في تاريخ هذه السلسلة، مع تحسينات تشمل الشاشة والأداء والكاميرات وقدرات الذكاء الاصطناعي، مع الحفاظ على التصميم المدمج للجهاز. ويأتي الجهاز بشاشة Super Retina XDR OLED مقاس 8.5 بوصة، تتميز بحواف رقيقة ونسبة تباين تبلغ 2,000,000:1، ودعم نطاق الألوان P3، وسطوع يصل إلى 1200 شمعة، فضلاً عن طبقة نانوية خاصة للحد من التوهج. ويعمل iPad mini الجديد بمعالج A20 Pro المصنّع بتقنية 2 نانومتر، وهي التقنية نفسها المستخدمة في سلسلة iPhone 18 Pro. وبحسب آبل، يوفر المعالج زيادة في أداء وحدة المعالجة المركزية تصل إلى 60% مقارنة بالجيل السابق، فيما ارتفع أداء الرسومات إلى 2.7 ضعف. ويتضمن الجهاز أيضاً مسرّعاً عصبياً مخصصاً داخل كل وحدة معالجة رسومية لتسريع مهام الذكاء الاصطناعي، مع تحسن في أداء هذه المهام يصل إلى 4.5 ضعف، وفق الشركة. وفي مجال التصوير، زُوّد الجهاز بكاميرا أمامية بدقة 12 ميغابيكسل تدعم ميزة Center Stage، التي تُبقي المستخدم ضمن إطار الصورة تلقائياً أثناء مكالمات الفيديو، إلى جانب كاميرا خلفية بالدقة نفسها تدعم تسجيل فيديو بدقة 4K وبمعدل 60 إطاراً في الثانية. ويعمل الجهاز بنظام iPadOS 27، الذي يتضمن تحسينات لميزات Apple Intelligence ومساعد Siri المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي، كما يدعم قلمي Apple Pencil Pro وApple Pencil، فيما تتضمن بعض طرازاته تقنية eSIM للاتصال بالشبكات الخلوية. ومن المقرر فتح باب الحجز المسبق للجهاز في 28 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر في 36 دولة، بينها الولايات المتحدة، على أن يبدأ وصوله إلى العملاء في 6 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر.

tr.title: Bursa'da 2 bin yıllık tarih yok oluyor: Roma döneminden kalan dev yapı yıkılmaya başladı!
tr.description: Bursa'nın İznik ilçesinde Roma İmparatoru Hadrianus döneminde inşa edilen yaklaşık 2 bin yıllık tarihi su kemeri, bakımsızlık ve ağaç köklerinin verdiği zarar nedeniyle yok olma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya. Yaklaşık 1 kilometre uzunluğundaki tarihi yapının bazı bölümlerinde çökmeler yaşanırken, vatandaşlar yetkililere acil restorasyon çağrısında bulundu. Bursa'nın tarihi ve kültürel zenginlikleriyle öne çıkan İznik ilçesinde, Roma İmparatorluğu döneminden günümüze ulaşan tarihi su kemeri için endişeler artıyor. Roma İmparatoru Hadrianus döneminde, milattan sonra 117-138 yılları arasında inşa edilen ve Abdulvahap Yolu üzerinde bulunan yaklaşık 1 kilometre uzunluğundaki yapı, bakımsızlık nedeniyle zarar görüyor. Taşların arasına giren ağaç köklerinin tarihi dokuyu tahrip ettiği belirtilirken, su kemerinin bazı bölümlerinde yıkılmalar meydana geldi. BURSA İZNİK'TE 2 BİN YILLIK TARİH TEHLİKE ALTINDA Bursa'nın medeniyetler beşiği olarak bilinen İznik ilçesi, Roma İmparatorluğu döneminden kalan önemli bir tarihi yapıya ev sahipliği yapıyor. Roma İmparatoru Hadrianus döneminde inşa edilen ve yaklaşık 2 bin yıllık geçmişe sahip olan tarihi su kemeri, Abdulvahap Yolu üzerinde bulunuyor. Yaklaşık 1 kilometre uzunluğundaki devasa yapı, Roma döneminin mimari mirasını günümüze taşıyan önemli eserler arasında yer alıyor. Ancak yakın tarihe kadar aktif olarak kullanıldığı belirtilen tarihi su kemeri, bakımsızlık ve doğal etkenler nedeniyle giderek daha fazla zarar görüyor. AĞAÇ KÖKLERİ TARİHİ SU KEMERİNİ PARÇALIYOR İznik'teki tarihi yapının karşı karşıya olduğu en önemli sorunlardan biri, kemerlerin çevresinde kontrolsüz şekilde büyüyen ağaçlar oldu. Zaman içerisinde taş ve tuğla blokların arasına giren ağaç kökleri, büyüdükçe tarihi yapının üzerinde baskı oluşturdu. Köklerin neden olduğu basınç nedeniyle bazı taş ve tuğla blokların yerinden oynadığı, su kemerinin çeşitli bölümlerinde çökmeler ve parçalanmalar meydana geldiği belirtildi. Yaklaşık 2 bin yıldır ayakta kalan tarihi yapının bazı kısımlarının yıkılmaya başlaması, bölgedeki tarihi mirasın korunmasına yönelik endişeleri artırdı. ROMA İMPARATORU HADRIANUS DÖNEMİNDEN GÜNÜMÜZE ULAŞTI İznik'teki tarihi su kemeri, Roma İmparatoru Hadrianus'un hüküm sürdüğü milattan sonra 117-138 yılları arasında inşa edildi. Aradan geçen yaklaşık 2 bin yıla rağmen günümüze ulaşmayı başaran yapı, ilçenin Roma dönemine uzanan tarihinin önemli izlerinden biri olarak dikkat çekiyor. Yakın tarihe kadar aktif olarak kullanıldığı belirtilen su kemeri, yaklaşık 1 kilometrelik uzunluğuyla bölgenin dikkat çeken mimari eserleri arasında bulunuyor. Ancak zamanın ve doğa koşullarının etkisiyle yıpranan tarihi yapının bazı bölümlerinde meydana gelen hasarlar, korunması için müdahale edilmesi gerektiğini ortaya koyuyor. VATANDAŞLARDAN ACİL RESTORASYON ÇAĞRISI İznik'teki tarihi su kemerinin giderek zarar görmesine bölge sakinleri ve tarih meraklıları tepki gösterdi. Yaklaşık 2 bin yıllık geçmişe sahip yapının daha fazla tahrip olmadan koruma altına alınmasını isteyen vatandaşlar, yetkililere çağrıda bulundu. Özellikle kemerlerin çevresinde büyüyen ağaçların ve taşların arasına giren köklerin oluşturduğu hasarın önlenmesi gerektiği vurgulandı. Bölge sakinleri, tarihi su kemerinin çevresinde gerekli temizlik çalışmalarının yapılmasını ve restorasyon sürecinin bir an önce başlatılmasını talep etti. İZNİK'İN TARİHİ MİRASI KORUNMAYI BEKLİYOR Farklı medeniyetlere ev sahipliği yapan Bursa'nın İznik ilçesinde, Roma döneminden kalan su kemerinin korunması büyük önem taşıyor. Yaklaşık 1 kilometre boyunca uzanan tarihi yapının çeşitli bölümlerinde yaşanan çökmeler, eserin geleceğine ilişkin endişeleri gündeme getiriyor. Bölge sakinleri ve tarih meraklıları, insanlığın ortak kültürel mirası olarak gördükleri su kemerinin daha fazla zarar görmemesi için yetkililerin harekete geçmesini bekliyor. İznik'te yaklaşık 2 bin yıldır ayakta kalan tarihi su kemerinin korunması için temizlik, bakım ve restorasyon çalışmalarının başlatılması isteniyor.

tr.title: İstanbul'da yağış sonrası araçlar yine su altında kaldı
tr.description: Geçtiğimiz günlerde yaşanan sel felaketinin izleri daha silinmeden İstanbul'dan bir korkutan görüntü daha geldi. Şiddetli yağışların ardından Tuzla ve Pendik'te araçlar su altında kaldı. İşe gidenler zor anlar yaşarken su seviyelerinin daha da yükselme ihtimali korkuttu. İstanbul’da gece saatlerinde itibaren etkisini gösteren sağanak yağış sonrası Tuzla ve Pendik’te yollar adeta göle dönerken, bazı araçlar su birikintilerinin içinde mahsur kaldı. SU BASKINLARI YAŞANDI Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü’nün yaptığı uyarıların ardından, İstanbul’da sağanak yağış gecenin ilk saatlerinden itibaren etkisini giderek arttırdı. Sabahın ilk saatlerinde ise Anadolu Yakası’nda en çok yağış alan bölgeler olan Tuzla ve Pendik’te cadde ve sokaklarda su baskınları meydana geldi. Bazı yol ve alt geçitler suyla kaplanarak adeta göle döndü. Su basan bazı bölgelerde araçlar su içinde mahsur kaldı. İŞE GİDENLER ZORLANDI İstanbul'da sabahın erken saatlerinde etkili olan sağanak yağış, işe gitmek için yola çıkan vatandaşlara zor anlar yaşattı. Bazı vatandaşlar şemsiyeleriyle yağmurdan korunmaya çalışırken, bazıları ise yağıştan etkilenmemek için koşarak ilerledi. Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğünün değerlendirmelerine göre, yağışlı havanın hafta boyunca etkisini sürdürmesi bekleniyor. "CANIMIZI ZOR KURTARDIK" Meteorolojinin uyarısının ardından İstanbul’da gece saatlerinde başlayan ve sabahın erken saatlerinde şiddetini artıran yağış, Pendik Çamçeşme Mahallesi’nde de hayatı olumsuz etkiledi. Yağış nedeniyle mahalledeki alt geçit suyla dolarken; alt geçitten geçmeye çalışan Cengiz Bektaş’ın aracı suyun içinde stop etti. Kızını üniversiteye götürmek için yola çıktığını belirten Bektaş, kızıyla birlikte mahsur kaldıklarını ve çevredekilerin yardımıyla araçtan çıktıklarını söyledi. Bektaş, aracını çıkarmak için çağırdığı çekiciyi beklediğini ifade etti. Yoğun yağış nedeniyle zor anlar yaşayan sürücü Cengiz Bektaş, "Sabah geçerken servis minibüsleri de dahil herkes geçiyordu. Ben de geçerken bir anda araba stop etti. Canımızı zor kurtardık. Sabah kızımı üniversiteye götürüyordum. Yardım edip bizi buradan çıkardılar. Çekiciyi çağırdım, onu bekliyorum" dedi.

za.title: Seven Fishermen Rescued Through Ghana-Togo-Benin Maritime Cooperation
za.description: The Ministry of Fisheries and Aquaculture on 23 October 2026 held a press conference at Ngyiresia, a fishing community in Sekondi, to welcome seven Ghanaian fishermen who were successfully rescued following a coordinated multinational search-and-rescue operation. The event also marked their return to their families and community. The fishermen, who went missing during a fishing expedition off Axim, were located approximately three nautical miles off Grand-Popo in Beninese waters following a distress alert on 21 October. The operation involved the navies of Ghana, Togo and Benin, with support from the Ghana Air Force and other security agencies. The Togolese Navy patrol vessel OTI located the distressed canoe, and all seven fishermen were rescued and provided with assistance. The Minister for Fisheries and Aquaculture, Hon. Emelia Arthur, described the rescue as a remarkable demonstration of regional cooperation, institutional collaboration and the importance of maritime safety. On behalf of the President and the people of Ghana, she expressed appreciation to all participating institutions, particularly the governments and maritime authorities of Togo and Benin. She also commended the chief fishermen for their support and contribution to the rescue efforts. Dr. Eric Cobbinah, Esq., Deputy Executive Director of the Fisheries Commission, highlighted the strong collaboration among fisheries institutions, security agencies and coastal fishing communities that contributed to the successful rescue. Commander Charles Darkwah of the Ghana Navy, speaking on behalf of Commodore Faustina Boachie, emphasised the importance of information-sharing and coordinated search efforts. He identified communication difficulties, the absence of distress-signalling transponders aboard the canoe and inadequate night-vision capabilities as key challenges encountered during the operation. He called for sustained investment in maritime surveillance, reliable communication systems and enhanced naval capabilities, including suitable vessels, high-speed interceptor boats and long-endurance maritime drones, to strengthen maritime monitoring and emergency response. The Minister also emphasised the need for improved tracking systems and modern safety equipment to help locate fishers in distress. The Ministry urged fisherfolk to observe maritime safety protocols, use appropriate safety equipment and work closely with relevant authorities to strengthen safety at sea. The Ministry expressed its appreciation to all institutions and individuals whose efforts contributed to the safe return of the seven fishermen to their families and community. za.title: Nigeria: Defining a Strategic Roadmap to Modernise Regional Data Governance
za.description: The ECOWAS Commission is called upon to increase the allocation of financial resources to this Directorate. This budgetary increase is deemed essential to reduce the Directorate’s dependence on development partners and to ensure the sustainability of statistical activities in the West African region, given the importance of adequate funding for research and statistical activities. Also addressed to the Commission, the DRS recommends the development of a regional data governance framework as a prerequisite for any expansion of digital platforms, databases and applications based on artificial intelligence (AI). At a technical and operational level, several recommendations have been made to the DRS. In particular, it must establish a regional technical working group to strengthen coordination mechanisms between itself, ECOWAS Member States, the African Union Statistical Institute (STATAFRIC) and development partners, with a view to improving data exchange and harmonisation. Close collaboration will be required with other ECOWAS institutions, directorates and agencies to digitise and automate the collection, processing and dissemination of data. The DRS must also guide these other institutions, directorates and agencies through data validation processes, in particular by organising regular meetings of internal technical committees. In line with technological modernisation, participants urged the DRS to acquire new servers for data storage, as well as state-of-the-art statistical and econometric software, and to integrate geographic information systems (GIS) coupled with AI into its data management systems, with a view to improving analysis and optimising decision-making. The implementation of sophisticated data management practices – including standards relating to metadata, backups, version control and cybersecurity measures – as well as the dissemination of methodological guidelines on national accounts and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) by 30th November 2026, also forms part of the participants’ recommendations to the DRS. The Commission is also encouraged to produce regional statistics and publications as frequently as possible, including economic reports, scorecards and statistical notes. It is also asked to establish a regional performance scorecard to monitor the progress of ECOWAS Member States in relation to key statistical indicators, in particular national accounts and economic statistics. In terms of internal governance, the Director of Research and Statistics at the ECOWAS Commission, Samson Bel-Aube Nougbodohoué, has committed to strengthening staff skills, particularly in the areas of data governance, forecasting, research methods, digitalisation and the responsible use of AI. This skills development will be achieved through capacity-building programmes and continuous professional development. Mr Nougbodohoué will also need to ensure that the tasks assigned to staff members are aligned with their annual performance targets and the terms of their contracts, whilst fostering teamwork, mutual respect, trust, commitment, communication and social cohesion through the organisation of quarterly activities involving them. It should be noted that this strategic seminar provided an opportunity for participants to review the Directorate’s mandate, evaluate ongoing programmes, analyse institutional capacities and identify the Directorate’s strategic priorities and resource requirements. As a reminder, the Directorate of Research and Statistics (DRS) is responsible for statistics, research, data management, monitoring and analytical support. It occupies a key position within the ECOWAS Commission in that it supports the implementation, monitoring and reporting of strategic priorities. It is also responsible for providing the data, indicators, analytical outputs and monitoring frameworks necessary to measure progress towards the objectives of ECOWAS’s ‘Vision 2050’ as well as the new strategic priorities set by the current management of the regional organisation’s Commission. Distributed by APO Group on behalf of Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).
